title: Soft deprecation window and pin-assistant with compatibility shim
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Problem: Customers are surprised when a model variant they depend on is removed and end up pinning to older weights in unsupported ways. We need a low-friction, reliable deprecation workflow that: 1) gives predictable notice windows, 2) helps customers migrate via pinning assistant and migration adapters, and 3) provides an automated compatibility shim during a configurable soft-deprecation window to reduce outages.

Goal: Ship a formal "soft deprecation" flow and a Pin Assistant UI/CLI + compatibility shim that reduces breakage during model sunsets and drives customers to pinned or upgraded variants before hard removal. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, and Design work for the initial MVP (notice automation, pin assistant warnings, compatibility shim behavior, and migration docs).

Scope (MVP):
- Notice automation: customizable email/console notifications and in-API deprecation header for 60/30/7/1 day cadence.
- Pin Assistant: Console UX and SDK warnings that recommend equivalent model variants, show token/cost delta, and one-click pin or request upgrade.
- Compatibility shim (MVP behavioral transformer): a runtime adapter that can translate a small set of tokenization/response-format differences and route to a fall-back variant when the requested version is deprecated but still within soft-window.
- Migration assets: migration guide, sample scripts (SDK patching + prompt adapters), and a lightweight eval checklist to validate behavior changes.

Out of scope (for this ticket): full telemetry-driven auto-migration, legal notices for enterprise contracts, and complex adapter transformations that change model semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Automated deprecation notices are sent at 60/30/7/1 days via console banner and email for users with traffic to the to-be-deprecated variant.
Pin Assistant shows recommended replacement model, estimated token cost delta, and a one-click pin action in the Console. SDK warnings appear when unpinned clients call deprecated variants.
Compatibility shim can handle signature-level differences for at least two common model pairs (e.g., tokenizer variation and n-gram truncation) and is enabled only during the soft-deprecation window.
Migration guide with example SDK patch and a 10-case prompt checklist is published to Confluence and linked from the deprecation notice.
No customer-facing outages observed during a staged test with 3 pilot customers (internal test accounts) while shim is active.
tasks: PM: Draft communication cadence & policy (60/30/7/1) and template content
ENG: Implement deprecation header and notice endpoint in API
ENG: Build compatibility shim prototype and canary behind feature flag
Design: Pin Assistant UX mockups and confirm copy
PM/Eng: Create migration guide and sample SDK scripts
SRE: Run canary traffic test and produce metrics dashboard for errors/latency
Docs: Publish step-by-step migration checklist and link from Console
rollout_plan: Week 1: Implement notice endpoints and Console banner feature flag. Ship internal RFC and design attachments.
Week 2: Deliver Pin Assistant UX and API; add SDK warning hooks; start docs draft.
Week 3: Deploy compatibility shim behind feature flag; roll canary traffic for pilot customers; collect telemetry.
Week 4: Iterate on shim mappings, finalize migration guide, enable 60-day notices for next targeted variant sunset.
Post-MVP: Expand shim mapping coverage and integrate telemetry to recommend automatic migration paths.
